notes: The author asked for a round map ringed by hills so players cannot fall into the void, and said outright that no genre or mechanics are defined and the middle should stay open and flat - so this is No Genre, with the axes carrying the answer instead of a shape row. Boundary-edge is the request almost word for word, the map limit hidden behind a natural barrier, and terrain-relief carries the grassy hills that form it, which makes verticality tiered with nothing overhanging and routes P0 plus tiered. No preset was taken: Open Sandbox is the nearest fit but would drag in circulation paths and scattered pickups nobody asked for, and two picks already describe the whole request. Scale is a small arena a few hundred studs across, and I decided the flat open centre stays deliberately unfurnished so any game type can be dropped into it later.
